content.short: Affluent provides Telegram-native infrastructure for trustless asset management and automated earning strategies.
content.description: Affluent is infrastructure for trustless asset management. Its site describes secure earning directly in Telegram, automated strategies, and one-click deposits into products such as USDT and tokenized gold exposure. The product is aimed at making managed crypto earning simpler for users while keeping the workflow close to TON and Telegram. Infrastructure for Trustless Asset Management. For builders, it is part of the TON infrastructure layer: APIs, data access, monitoring, compliance, indexing, or operational support.
content.meta: Affluent provides Telegram-native infrastructure for trustless asset management. Discover its TON infrastructure role and related developer services on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
